root_cause.text: The generic power domain (genpd) core fails to disable runtime PM for virtual devices during detachment in `genpd_dev_pm_detach()`, leaving runtime PM enabled on detached devices.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a check `is_virt_dev = dev->bus == &genpd_bus_type` and calls `pm_runtime_disable(dev)` inside `genpd_dev_pm_detach()` to clean up the runtime PM state that was enabled during attachment.

intent_record.intent_summary: Refactor genpd device detachment to use the virtual device flag instead of checking the bus type directly.

intent_record.how: Determines whether to unregister the device based on the 'is_virt_dev' flag instead of dynamically checking its bus type at the time of detachment.
